category: Company Update / Press Release / Media Release
summary: Knack Packaging posted its unaudited Q1 FY27 results, reporting revenue of about Rs 2.6 billion, up 41% year‑on‑year, with EBITDA and profit after tax rising 53% and 48% respectively. Margins improved slightly and return ratios were strong, while manufacturing capacity increased to over 48,000 MT per year.
why: Demonstrates robust growth and profitability post‑IPO, signalling strong shareholder value creation.

category: Company Update / Award of Order / Receipt of Order
summary: ARSS Infrastructure Projects Ltd received a work order worth Rs 19.78 crore for widening and strengthening Danagadi‑Bangarkata road in Jajpur district, covering 27.040 km over 21 months.
why: Adds a significant contract to the company’s revenue pipeline, indicating business growth.

summary: Orbit Exports Ltd has declared a first interim dividend of Rs. 0.50 per share for the financial year 2026-27 alongside reporting its June quarter financial results. The company also announced the record date for the dividend and the schedule for its upcoming annual general meeting.
why: A dividend payout alongside solid quarterly earnings provides direct cash returns and signals financial health to shareholders.

summary: The board approved a buy‑back of up to 1.394 million shares (about 1.24% of equity) at a maximum price of Rs 500 per share, totaling no more than Rs 697 million. It also approved buying the remaining 4.28% of JC Biotech to make it wholly owned and a fresh equity/IDC infusion of up to Rs 20 million into its subsidiary ANPL.
numbers: Maximum buy‑back price Rs 500 per share
Additional infusion up to Rs 20 million
why: Provides a cash return to shareholders and can lift earnings per share and share price.

category: Company Update / Award of Order / Receipt of Order
summary: Cemindia Projects received a GST demand order from the tax authorities in Ahmedabad for FY 2020-21 regarding a mismatch in input tax credit. The department has levied a tax and penalty of Rs. 1.24 Crore each. The company plans to appeal and does not expect a material financial impact.
numbers: Tax and penalty Rs. 1.24 Crore each
why: Tax demand notices create short-term regulatory overhang, though management does not foresee material financial harm.

summary: Studds announced further investment in its wholly‑owned subsidiaries SMK Helmets Europe SRL (up to €10 lakh) and Bikerz US Inc. (USD 99,936). It also released unaudited Q2 results showing a profit of ₹132.52 million and revenue of ₹1,669.43 million.
numbers: Investment in SMK Helmets Europe SRL up to EUR 10,00,000
Investment in Bikerz US Inc. USD 99,936
Profit for quarter ended June 30 2026 ₹132.52 million
Revenue for quarter ended June 30 2026 ₹1,669.43 million
why: It signals the company’s intent to strengthen its distribution network in Europe and the US, potentially boosting future sales.

category: Board Meeting / Outcome of Board Meeting
summary: Aptus Pharma Limited announced its board's approval to issue 16,10,100 equity shares on a preferential basis to 192 investors. The board also fixed September 14, 2026, as the date for its Annual General Meeting and appointed a registered valuer to determine the issue price.
numbers: Total Number of Securities 16,10,100 equity shares
why: Preferential issues dilute existing shareholders' equity, though the exact pricing details are yet to be finalized by the registered valuer.
